scope: Three exact production source paths only; state isolation prerequisite, not scanner dispatch or arbitrary timeframe-input validation.

checks.result: All production helper calls use the expanded signature. Stateful per-frame strategies receive extras.timeframe; existing TradingLoop supplies ctx.candleTimeframe. No other production code accesses the old module map shape. Missing-symbol fallback is unchanged.

MtfConfluenceService intentionally uses null timeframe cache key, retaining one adapter per symbol and cross-frame aggregation. Per-evaluation confluence caching and latest candle timeframe ingestion are unchanged.

checks.topic: SmartMoney candle state and risk budget
checks.result: Separate timeframe modules share one dailyRiskState object per canonical symbol. First same-day evaluation of another timeframe cannot erase the shared loss count because risk day is distinct from each module IVB/session day. Other symbols retain distinct risk objects. Daily rollover clears shared loss count; IVB reset remains per module. No production caller of resetDaily or old dailyLosses property was found outside changed owners.

Only two production callers target orchestrator.recordTradeResult, both OrderExecutor close paths. Both now supply persisted entry trade timeframe. Result helper reuses that frame module and shared symbol risk object; a newly created frame still shares any existing symbol risk budget. Existing P&L direction/count semantics unchanged.

validation: Read exact candidate/base diff and qualified producer/caller sources; searched all tracked production JavaScript for helper calls, module-map access, resetDaily, dailyLosses, and result feedback. Behavioral execution and Mercury are performed separately by parent, not claimed by this static review.
limitations: Current TradingLoop remains pinned to ctx.candleTimeframe; multi-frame dispatch is not implemented or verified by this prerequisite.
Retained daily reset semantics use the input candle calendar day; this review does not claim arbitrary out-of-order history replay safety.
Test API callers must be updated for nested frame maps and shared dailyRiskState; no production compatibility wrapper or new gate recommended.
